welcome.lead: This is your home base for the 4th Annual Home Care Champions Experience, back in San Diego at Yard and Sea.
body: We are just getting started on this one. Speakers, the agenda, and everything else will land on this page as they are confirmed.
Bookmark it now. When we announce, this is where it shows up first.
In the meantime, the dates are set and the travel and accommodations details are already here, so you can start planning the trip.
Thank you for being part of this. We cannot wait to do it again.
